must-try street food in Nha Trang
Sep 2024 • Solo
banh can is a kind of street food in Nha Trang, it means rice flour pancake. banh can cooked in circular clay pans, each pancake is served with a variety of toppings, from shrimp and squid to dried or fresh meat.one night,after dinner, i came here for late night food, i ordered banh can special combo ,there are eight pieces in the combo, toppings included shrimp, squid, pork,beef, egg, baby clam… i think pancake with egg is the best. others actually not bad, but the toppings easily separated from the pancake, i meant when you use chopstick to pick up the pancake, the topping will falling down,make it hard to eat.better eat them seperately. the pancake quite bland, have to eat with dipping sauce, then much tastier. besides,i ordered a bottle of soya bean, which is nice. anyway, if you come to Nha Trang, banh can is a must-try food, at least try it once.

Paris, France19 contributions

You can enjoy cheap and delicious local food
Jan 2024 • Family
I went there because it was often featured on YouTube.
It is a local dish made by grilling shrimp and meat on a 7-8 cm diameter dough.
About three women were making it in front of the shop, with smoke billowing out.

Inside the shop, the customers were half tourists and half locals.
It was a hot day, even though it was January, and although there were several electric fans in use, the inside of the shop was still quite hot.
The shop was bustling with people eating while sitting on small chairs and tables.

I was told that each person could have one dish, so I thought that 6 pieces x 3 was a bit much, but I ordered shrimp, beef, and egg.
They were 150k, 40k, and 20k dong respectively, so about 1,200 yen in total (as of January 2024).
It is eaten by dipping it in cold soup with minced meat dumplings. I heard that the yellow thing is mango, and I was told that this is also eaten on top.
The dough is sweet, and when mixed with the soup, it is refreshing and very delicious.

My wife and daughter both have small appetites, so we had some left over, but we were still very satisfied.
It seems you can mix and match depending on how you order.
It's a restaurant I'd like to visit again.

Anthony Bourdain would love this place
Sep 2023 • Solo
The uniqueness of the front step cooks and the smoke greeting you will make you feel like you are going to dine with Anthony Bourdain. The service was fast and attentive and the food was hot and very tasty. This was the highlight of my food experience in Nha Trang, by a long shot. 

If you are a fussy tourist who wants everyone to speak English and treat you like a king, then go somewhere else so there will be tiny plastic seats for the rest of us! If you want to eat with friendly locals and enjoy a fantastic meal in an authentic joint, go here. 

There is a darn good reason there are a lot of people inside.
